name: Well of Corruption
summary: Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post asks you to collect corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell. She needs a sample brought back to her.

sections.title: Corrupted Water
sections.body: At Bloodvenom Post, Winna Hazzard asks you to bring her a sample of corrupted water. It comes from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell, and Winna is waiting for it.

faq.answer: Winna Hazzard asks you to bring her a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell.

faq.q: Where do I get the water sample?
faq.answer: The sample comes from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell.

faq.q: Who should I bring the sample to?
faq.answer: Bring the sample to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

attribution: In-game quest text: Well of Corruption
